name: Travel Devil
source:
Welcome one and all, to the most Sin-tilating travel vlog on earth and hell.  Explore the human world, learn how to blend in amongst the locals, see the sights and most importantly, get insider info on how to better corrupt the pathetic souls you'll meet. 

"Travel Devil" is the leader in infernal info-tainment, all thanks to your exceptional host and guide, Tornacense.

Tornacense rose to Doomtube stardom quickly, after seizing his opportunity when a macabre 19 year old college student attempted to summon a demon in order to get revenge on his enemies. Thus began an adventure of a lifetime, all be it , one the fortunate human did not intend. 

What you're are about to witness is the premier episode of this historic, ground breaking program, including some never before seen behind the scenes footage.

Our first stop on this momentous tour?

Paris!

[From [url=https://valhallions.itch.io/traveldevil]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎大家来到地球和地狱上最令人罪恶的旅行视频博客。探索人类世界，学习如何融入当地人，参观景点，最重要的是，获得有关如何更好地腐蚀你将遇到的可怜灵魂的内部信息。

“旅行魔鬼”是地狱信息娱乐领域的领导者，这一切都要归功于出色的主持人和导游Tornacense。

当一名可怕的19岁大学生试图召唤恶魔来向敌人复仇时，Tornacense抓住了这个机会，很快就成为了《Doomtube》的明星。就这样开始了一生的冒险，尽管这一切都是幸运的人类无意的。

你将看到的是这个具有历史意义、开创性的节目的第一集，其中包括一些以前从未见过的幕后花絮。

我们这次重要旅行的第一站？

巴黎！
